$comment: Deploy & Harden Phase 4c. Separate from contracts/price_book.json on
purpose: that file prices MEASURED usage (tokens/bytes this system
actually recorded via tools/usage_meter.py). This file prices
infrastructure this project has NO usage-measurement instrumentation
for yet (Cloud Run CPU/memory-seconds, Cloud SQL instance-hours,
Firestore per-operation, Pub/Sub, network egress) — evaluation/
estimate_ladder_cost.py uses these as ASSUMPTIONS for a full-stack
estimate, not as a measurement. Every figure below is a published
list rate with a source; re-verify and bump effective_date before
trusting an estimate that used a stale one.

cloud_sql_db_f1_micro_hour.$comment: Shared-core, single-zone — the demo/staging profile infrastructure/terraform/cloud_sql.tf uses, not a production HA tier.
